Aspect ratio calculator

Simplify a width-to-height ratio and calculate proportional dimensions.

Your result will appear here.

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Enter positive integer width and height values. The calculator divides both by their greatest common divisor. Enter a new width to calculate a proportional height rounded to the nearest pixel.

Try this example

1920 × 1080 simplifies to 16:9. At 1280 pixels wide, the matching height is 720.

How your data is handled ↗Smaller images, sharper results ↗

Good to know

Why can the final ratio differ slightly after resizing?

Pixel dimensions are whole numbers. Rounding a fractional calculated height can introduce a small ratio difference.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
